caption: The drawing depicts a single large, symmetrical object centered within a rectangular frame. The object resembles a goblet or chalice with a wide, flat base that narrows at the stem, then widens into a broad, rounded bowl. On top of the bowl is a lid with two elongated cylindrical rods protruding upward at an angle, forming a V-shape. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray, with the object itself drawn in a realistic, shaded style to suggest a metallic or stone-like material. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the grayscale object, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the drawing.
